description: List the delivery time windows Albert Heijn offers at the member's address, per day (Dutch time). Booking a slot is only possible in the AH app or on ah.nl; this shows when delivery is possible. Returns date and windows like '15:00-17:00'.

days.description: Number of days with slots to return (default 7)
